svg.text: Floor plan · roof grid A
10 x 10 m clear · buttress every 1.5 m · printed walls
Printed wall 400 (= roof base width). Buttresses
solid black: 400 wide (same as the wall), 1000 deep
from the inner face (flush with the wall inside), so
they project 600 outside; one about every 1.5 m (7
bays of 1486 on the wall centreline, 8 per side,
corners included).
Every other bay (the 2nd, 4th and 6th) is a
full-height curtain wall, the whole bay between two
buttresses; the middle bay of the south and north
walls has a 1000 door instead. The other bays stay
printed wall. Positions and sizes are placeholders.
Pyramid roof above (dashed): 1000 square crown, hips
to the corners, roof base 400 thick square to the
slope, so its outer edge lands about 59 outside the
wall face.
Buttress axes 1486 apart along each wall (centre to
centre), corners included.
Roof build-up outside the shell (outline at the
eave): insulation 100 (very thin line), then the
outer layer 30.
Cast ribs of roof grid A seen from above (dashed),
with the bottom ring (the 300 solid base) and the
horizontal / top rings.
from your sketches
assumed by me, to confirm
Notes
Section A-A cuts through the 4th buttress from the south
on the east and west walls (y = -743).
Detail D1 is the eave at the east buttress on that cut.
